negative_space_note: P08 describes v1's planned entity/relation graph layer, blended into RRF for multi-hop queries. This ticket's recall.what fusion does NOT implement any of that: it fuses flat, already-ranked domain lists (files, turns, memories) via plain RRF, with no entity/relation extraction, no community summaries, and no graph traversal. That surface is P2-deferred (05-PEWS-PLAN-W4-W6.md §Epic-V, GraphRAG deferred).
